answer: The velvet schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the mirror checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 60 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An attacker wanting 18 effective identities must lock that capital for 60 epochs and keep it locked through every haven audit. That is 17 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
